# Get today's date
today = frappe.utils.nowdate()

# Get today's weekday (Monday, Tuesday, etc.)
today_day = frappe.utils.formatdate(today, "EEEE")

# Get default company
default_company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")

# 1️⃣ Fetch customers from CHILD TABLE
customer_days = frappe.get_all(
    "Days",   # 👈 child doctype
    filters={
        "day": today_day,
        "parenttype": "Customer"
    },
    fields=["parent"]
)

customer_names = []
for d in customer_days:
    if d.parent not in customer_names:
        customer_names.append(d.parent)


if not customer_names:
    frappe.msgprint("No customers scheduled for today")
    

# 2️⃣ Fetch customers (parent) details
customers = frappe.get_all(
    "Customer",
    filters={
        "name": ["in", customer_names],
        "disabled": 0
    },
    fields=["name", "customer_name", "primary_address"]
)

for c in customers:

    # 3️⃣ Avoid duplicate invoice
    exists = frappe.db.exists(
        "Distributor Invoice",
        {
            "customer_name": c.name,
            "date": today,
            "docstatus": ["!=", 2]
        }
    )

    if exists:
        continue

    # 4️⃣ Build address
    address_html = ""
    if c.primary_address:
        address = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Address",
            c.primary_address,
            ["address_line1", "city", "state", "country"],
            as_dict=True
        )

        if address:
            address_html = "\n".join(filter(None, [
                address.address_line1,
                address.city,
                address.state,
                address.country
            ]))

    # 5️⃣ Create Distributor Invoice
    doc = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Distributor Invoice",
        "customer_name": c.name,
        "date": today,
        "company": default_company,
        "mode_payment": "Cash",
        "sales_type": "Sales",
        "bill_no": 123,  # replace with your logic
        "customer_address": address_html,
        "warehouse": "Abdullah Warehouse - AFI"
    })

    doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
